title: A New Informant
text: A maid from a merchant's house comes with news of her own accord. She wants only a few coins and discretion.

title: A Burned Dead Drop
text: Someone has searched the place where you leave messages. You need a new one.

title: A Coded Letter
text: By mistake a letter in an unknown cipher reaches you. Half the night goes on the key.

title: Payment from the Principal
text: The principal sends a purse with a note: 'Good work.'

title: A Stranger at the Door
text: Someone watches the safehouse from across the street. By morning they are gone.

title: Gossip from the Manor
text: A chambermaid from the manor tells who sleeps with whom. To someone it may be worth a fortune.

title: A False Lead
text: It turns out that last week's information was invented. Someone has fooled you.

title: A Forgotten Password
text: A contact forgot the password and the informant refuses to talk.

title: A Ball at the Town Hall
text: At the town hall ball the wine loosens tongues. The notes barely fit in a pocket.

title: Candles and Ink
text: The candles and ink are running out. Without them no reports can be written.

title: A Debt of Gratitude
text: A clerk you once helped sends a copy of an important document.

title: An Arrest at the Market
text: The watch detains one of your people at the market. They let them go in the evening, but everyone is afraid.

title: A Courier without a Horse
text: A dead horse with a broken leg lies on the road. The rider is gone, but the satchel of letters is in the bushes.

title: The Crossroads Inn
text: The innkeeper at the crossroads sees every traveller. For a few coins they tell who rode through this week.

title: The Castle on the Hill
text: From the hill you can see the count's castle. Someone counts the carts passing the gate.

title: The Hermit's Hut
text: A forest hermit knows more about the area than many a clerk, and wants only salt in return.

title: A Watched Pass
text: Someone is watching the pass from across the valley. Nobody knows whether it is a warden or a rival's spy.

title: The Wrong Map
text: The map from the chancery turns out to be wrong. The network wanders the wilds for half a day.

title: A Courier's Trail
text: Fresh prints of a shod horse show in the mud. Someone rode in haste to the castle.

title: The Cipher Broken
text: After three nights over the letter someone finally finds the key. The contents are worth every candle.

title: A Double Agent
text: One of the informants also sells news to a rival. You must decide what else to tell them.

title: An Advance from the Principal
text: The principal sends an advance for expenses. The letter ends: “I need names.”

title: Burned Notes
text: Someone burns old notes in the stove. It is safer, but some knowledge is lost.

title: News from the Elector's Court
text: A courier from a distant city brings gossip from the Elector's court. The principal will surely pay for a copy.

title: The Neighbour Questioned
text: The watch questions the neighbour downstairs. The walls are thin, so the network keeps silent all night.

title: A Wax Impression
text: Someone has pressed the burgomaster's seal into wax. Such an impression opens many doors.

title: An Expensive Supper
text: A clerk will talk only over a good supper. The bill is high and the news meagre.

title: An Unsigned Note
text: A child brings an unsigned note: “I know where you live.”

title: A Grateful Widow
text: A widow you helped recover her inheritance sends a basket of food and the name of a notary who takes bribes.

title: The Lost Key
text: The key to the chest of files is lost. By morning the lock must be forced and a new hiding place found.

title: A Witness from the Past
text: Someone in the inn recognises a former member of the network. Luckily they are too drunk to remember anything in the morning.

title: A Map of the Sewers
text: For a few coins an old ratcatcher draws a map of the sewers under the merchant quarter.

title: Talk through the Wall
text: In the room next to the inn two men talk of money and names.
okText: The eavesdropper puts a cup to the wall and writes down every word.

title: An Urgent Message
text: A message must reach the principal before dawn, and the gates are shut.
okText: The courier climbs the wall by the old tannery and is back before cockcrow.

title: A Blackmailer
text: Someone threatens to give away the safehouse unless they are paid.
okText: The enforcer pays them a night visit. In the morning the blackmailer leaves town.

title: A Tail
text: Since the morning someone has been following one of the contacts.
okText: The shadow leads the tail into a blind alley and vanishes from sight.

title: A Buyer for a Secret
text: Someone wants to buy information, but offers a laughable price.
okText: The fixer haggles until the price becomes serious.

title: A False Identity
text: Someone arrives in town who knows the real name of one of you.
okText: The chameleon convinces them they are mistaken and buys them a beer.

title: A Talkative Messenger
text: A messenger in the inn boasts of carrying an important letter.
okText: The eavesdropper joins them with a jug and by midnight knows the recipient and the contents.

title: The Bridge Is Down
text: A message must reach the far bank, and the flood has taken the bridge.
okText: The courier crosses the river on the stones and comes back soaked, but with an answer.

title: Robbers on the Road
text: Robbers stop the network on the road and demand purses.
okText: The enforcer settles it so quickly that the robbers flee without their weapons.

title: A Rival's Spy
text: Someone from a rival network hangs around the safehouse.
okText: The shadow follows them all the way to their principal. Now you know more.

title: A Contact Gone Cold
text: A clerk who always took bribes suddenly refuses.
okText: The go-between finds the clerk's weakness, and the clerk is eager to help again.

title: Fever in the Safehouse
text: An informant lies in a fever, raving names aloud.
okText: The chameleon doses them with bark tea and makes sure no stranger hears.
